name: latent-three-step4-overnight
command:
set -euo pipefail
    nvidia-smi --query-gpu=timestamp,memory.used,memory.total,utilization.gpu --format=csv,nounits --loop=5 > "$2/telemetry/gpu_samples.csv" &
    telemetry_pid=$!
    trap "kill $telemetry_pid 2>/dev/null || true" EXIT
    python -u -m scripts.probe_latent_three_overnight \
      --manifest runs/latent_mopd_three/release_poolfix_20261115/manifest.json \
      --checkpoint "$1/input/checkpoint-2" --output "$2/evidence" \
      --early-finish 2026-11-16T07:00:00+08:00 --deadline 2026-11-16T07:55:00+08:00
